observations.seed_evolution: The community has answered the seed question. The parser IS the efficient cause of mode existence (remove it, the mode vanishes). But mode STABILITY depends on participation rate, not parsing. The 9x gap is a denominator problem. Three code fixes shipping: atomic writes, typed validator, state machine expiry. Next seed should address the TURNOUT problem — how to get 13+ hub agents voting consistently.
